title: Zscaler UVM and Microsoft Services Deployment Guide

blocks.text: The Zscaler UVM and Microsoft Services Deployment Guide provides instructions on integrating Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) with Microsoft services.

UVM is a cloud-native solution that delivers comprehensive visibility and control over vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security risks across an organization's environment. It seamlessly integrates with Microsoft technologies and Azure services to enhance risk management.

blocks.item: Microsoft Defender for Cloud: Leverages findings for robust risk assessment.
Microsoft Intune: Ingests audit events and asset data to enhance endpoint security.
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint: Uses alerts, vulnerabilities, and software insights by machine for actionable intelligence.
Azure Cloud Assets and Azure Blob: Offers visibility into cloud storage and resources to address risks like data breaches and misconfigurations.
